study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two datasets from different Peking University centers (healthy dataset and clinical dataset) are described.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The participants of this study were drawn from 2 datasets. The healthy dataset included 409 healthy control (HC) participants (HCtrain group) recruited from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University. The clinical dataset consisted of 324 individuals: 56 individuals with MDD, 31 individuals with BD, 73 individuals with SZ, and 164 HC participants (HCtest group). These participants were recruited from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCtrain is the training sample; HCtest is used for replicate validation/testing alongside patients for deviation evaluation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We set the HCtrain group as the training sample to establish the normative reference, and the testing sample that comprised the clinical dataset (HCtest group) was positioned on the normative percentile charts for replicate validation and individualized evaluation.
